headline: Public hearing on changes to form-based code standards and the accessory dwelling unit definition.
summary: A public hearing on LDR-26-12 comes first. Four proposed zoning amendments may then be advanced to City Council, covering bedrock removal, natural communities, and Act 250 DRB authority.
items: Public hearing on LDR-26-12: amendment on form-based code standards and accessory dwelling unit definition update (7:10 PM)
Potential votes to advance LDR amendments to City Council (7:25 PM)
LDR-26-09: significant natural communities and rare, threatened, or endangered species update
LDR-26-11: Act 250 Tier 1A DRB authority in form-based code area
LDR-25-12: minor amendments to form-based code standards and accessory dwelling unit definition
Notice of draft amendments to the Williston Unified Development Bylaw on December 1, 2026
